info.title: Einar Gate API
info.description: The public API of Einar Gate. Errors are RFC 9457 problem details (`application/problem+json`); clients must ignore unknown response members, tolerate unknown enum values and handle an unknown problem type by its HTTP status.

bearerAuth.description: The value of an API key, `Authorization: Bearer egk_…`. API keys are created in the Einar Gate app, and a value is shown once.

InvalidRequestProblem.description: Invalid request. Fix the members that `errors[]` lists and send the request again. A body member’s path is bare (`licensePlate`); query and path parameters are prefixed `query.` and `path.`.

UnauthorizedProblem.description: Unauthorized. Send a working API key value as `Authorization: Bearer egk_…`. A value stops working when it is revoked, or retired after a rotation: get the current one from whoever manages the API key in the Einar Gate app.

ForbiddenProblem.description: Forbidden. The API key lacks a role for this action, the path names another location, or the action needs an active subscription. `GET /me` shows the key’s roles, location and subscription state; a location Owner or Admin changes its roles in the app.

NotFoundProblem.description: Not found. Use ids exactly as the API returned them, under the API key’s own location, and URL-encode permission ids. Never build an id.

ConflictProblem.description: Conflict. The entity already exists (for a permission: the camera already has the plate and country) or was changed at the same time. Read it again before deciding; a concurrent change is safe to retry.

IdempotencyKeyInFlightProblem.description: Idempotency key in flight. A request with the same `Idempotency-Key` is still running: wait a moment and retry with the same key.

InvalidOwnerProblem.description: Invalid owner. Set `ownerUserId` to the `userId` of a member whose status is `member` (`GET /locations/{locationId}/members`).

LimitExceededProblem.description: Limit exceeded. A limit of the location’s plan or of the owner would be exceeded; the location’s `limits` show them. Remove permissions first, or ask the location Owner to change the plan.

GateNotOperableProblem.description: Gate not operable. The gate cannot be opened now: it has no control camera, the camera is offline, or the gate is not set up for control. Check its `gateControlCameraId` and that camera’s `connection.status`.

IdempotencyKeyReuseProblem.description: Idempotency key reused. The `Idempotency-Key` was used for a different request in the last 24 hours: send a new request with a new key.

RateLimitedProblem.description: Rate limit exceeded. Wait `Retry-After` seconds when `window` is `second`, or until the next day when it is `day`. Every API key of the location shares the limits that `GET /me` shows.

InternalProblem.description: Internal error. An unexpected error on our side. Retry later, and send the `requestId` to support if it persists. Before retrying a gate opening, check the events: the gate may have opened.

ProvisioningProblem.description: Provisioning in progress. The location’s first API key was created moments ago: retry after `Retry-After` seconds.

ServiceUnavailableProblem.description: Service unavailable. A dependency was briefly unavailable: send the same request again after a short wait, with the same `Idempotency-Key` for a write.

requestsPerSecond.description: Sustained requests per second for the location

burst.description: Requests the location may send at once before throttling

requestsPerDay.description: Daily quota of the location; it resets at the start of each day

RateLimit.description: The configured limits, shared by all API keys of the location. Live counters are not available.

roles.description: The roles the API key holds at its location

subscriptionActive.description: Whether the location's subscription is active. Opening gates requires an active subscription.

LocationLimits.description: The location’s limits. A limit that is not set is the default of the location’s plan.

defaultLicensePlateCountry.description: The country a permission gets when it is created without one

subscriptionActive.description: Opening gates requires an active subscription

eventRetentionDays.description: How many days events are kept; not set when they are kept indefinitely

userId.description: Set once the user has an account; a permission’s owner must be a member whose status is `member`

status.description: Only a `member` can own permissions; the others are invitations in progress or a membership being removed

Member.description: A member or an invitee of the location

continuationToken.description: Present when there are more items: pass it to get them

manualOperation.description: Whether any member of the location may open it in the app

Camera.description: A camera registered at a gate

continuationToken.description: Present when there are more items: pass it to get them

permissionId.description: **Opaque: store it as it is and URL-encode it in paths.** Find a permission by plate with the `licensePlate` filter instead of building an id.

licensePlateCountry.description: Upper-case; an empty string when the plate has no country

Permission.description: A plate’s permission on one camera. The owner’s private name and comment are never exposed.

continuationToken.description: Present when there are more items: pass it to get them

FailedCamera.description: A camera that did not get the permission: `conflict` when it already has one for the plate and country, `limit-exceeded` when a plate limit of the location or the owner would be exceeded

created.description: Never empty: when no camera got it, the answer is a problem

CreatePermissionResult.description: The permission as added to each camera that got it, and the cameras that did not

licensePlate.description: As typed; whitespace and dashes are removed

licensePlateCountry.description: The location’s `defaultLicensePlateCountry` when not given; an empty string for a plate without a country

ownerUserId.description: A member of the location whose status is `member`; the plate counts against their limit

licensePlate.description: As typed; changing it changes the `permissionId`, which the response returns

licensePlateCountry.description: An empty string for a plate without a country

ReplacePermission.description: The full representation of the permission’s fields an API key manages; a field that is not given is removed. The owner cannot be changed, and the owner’s private name and comment are kept.

status.description: A manual opening’s snapshot: requested from the camera, uploaded, or failed

url.description: A presigned URL, valid for 15 minutes; set once the file is uploaded

post.description: Sends the open command to the gate’s control camera and answers the manual opening event while it is still pending: its snapshots are requested from the gate’s cameras, and `GET /events/{eventId}` shows them once they arrive. Requires an active subscription. No body. Send an `Idempotency-Key` so that a retry does not open the gate twice.

schema.description: The location; always the API key’s own
A gate of the location
Makes the request idempotent for 24 hours: a retry with the same key and request replays the first response.

post.summary: Permit a plate at every camera of the location
post.description: The plate is added camera by camera. The answer is `201` when at least one camera got it, listing the cameras that did not with a problem each (`conflict`: it already has the plate; `limit-exceeded`: a plate limit would be exceeded). When no camera got it, the answer is that problem: `conflict` if every camera already has the plate, `limit-exceeded` otherwise. The owner must be a member whose status is `member` (`invalid-owner`). Send an `Idempotency-Key` to retry safely.

schema.description: The location; always the API key’s own
Makes the request idempotent for 24 hours: a retry with the same key and request replays the first response.
